title: Wheely Bits | Fitment Engine (Daylight)
prompt:
Convert the Fitment Engine to a clean, light-mode technical calculator.

Key Changes:
- Page Background: Light grey.
- Input Fields: Pure white backgrounds with subtle silver borders and orange focus rings.
- Comparison Table: High-contrast text on alternating light grey rows.
- Verdict Cards: Keep the green/yellow/red semantic colors but adapt the card backgrounds to be light versions (e.g., very pale green background with a solid green border) for better legibility in light mode.
- Typography: Ensure all technical mono-spaced data (PCD, Offset) is in a dark, high-contrast grey.

title: Wheely Bits | Vehicle Selection (Updated)
prompt:
Transform the Vehicle Selection page (SCREEN_63) to match the layout and visual style of the Wrap Visualization page (SCREEN_44). 

Key requirements:
1. Use the cinematic dark background and centered capsule navigation from SCREEN_44.
2. Replace the current grid of popular makes and featured models with a more focused interface.
3. Add two prominent, glassmorphic dropdown menus at the center: one for 'Car Brand' and another for 'Car Model'. 
4. Maintain the 'Selected Vehicle' confirmation bar at the bottom, but style it to match the 'Configuration Details' aesthetics from SCREEN_44.
5. Keep the British Racing Green Porsche 911 GT3 RS as the background/reference image to maintain continuity.
6. Ensure all typography and spacing align with the Slate & Sage design system.

title: Wheely Bits | Tint Visualization (Slate & Sage)
prompt:
The third stage of the Tint Journey: 'Visualization'. 
Navigation: Floating centered capsule with 'Tint' active. 
Progress Bar: Step 1 and 2 complete, Step 3 (Visualization) active. 
Main Content: A cinematic 3D environment featuring a car (e.g., a white or silver sports car to contrast the tint). 
Interactive Elements: A slider to adjust the tint shade in real-time, toggle buttons for 'Day' and 'Night' view, and a 'Interior View' vs 'Exterior View' toggle. 
Side Panel: Summary of the build (e.g., Ceramic Film, 35% Shade). 
CTA: 'Confirm Selection'. 
Theme: Slate & Sage.

title: Wheely Bits | Fitment Engine (Slate & Sage)
prompt:
The Fitment Engine calculator page.
- Layout: Two main rounded columns: "Your Vehicle" and "Your Rim".
- Technical UI: Soft slate input fields with rounded corners and subtle sage green borders on focus.
- Results: A "Safe Direct Fit" status indicator with a soft glow. A "Technical Comparison" table and a "Tyre Matrix" card.
- Animations: Smooth expansion animations for technical details.
